objectives: Turn a customer inquiry into an actionable record.
explanation: Begin with the outcome the customer wants and the problem they experience. Use open questions, then confirm specifics: site type, affected area, existing equipment, constraints and desired timing. Read back your understanding in plain language. Do not collect credentials or unnecessary personal data to make the record look complete.

A useful request record distinguishes customer statements from confirmed observations. Include a reference, contact channel authorized for follow-up, scope, open questions and the next responsible action. lessons.title: Complaints and professional communication
objectives: Acknowledge a complaint and agree a next step without unsupported promises.
explanation: Listen without interrupting, summarize the issue and acknowledge its impact. Ask focused questions to establish what happened and what outcome the customer seeks. Avoid assigning blame before evidence is available. A respectful acknowledgement can be accurate without admitting an unverified cause or promising compensation.

Record the complaint, impact, evidence available, agreed contact method and next update. Escalate to the authorized responsible function when the request exceeds your role. Do not invent a refund rule or service deadline. If language becomes abusive or safety is threatened, seek the applicable supervisor/site response instead of escalating the confrontation.
lessons.example: Cedar Office reports that a missed appointment interrupted work. “I understand this disrupted your schedule. I will record the details and ask the responsible team to confirm the next step.”
lessons.exercise: Draft a complaint response containing acknowledgement, clarification and a realistic next action.
lessons.model_response: I understand the disruption. Please confirm the appointment reference and what occurred. I will ask the responsible team to review it and agree the next update with you.

lessons.title: Quotations and sales coordination
objectives: Check scope and assumptions before a quotation is issued.
explanation: A quotation should make the proposed scope understandable: items or services, quantities, relevant specifications, assumptions, exclusions and commercial terms supplied by the authorized process. This course does not set AITS pricing, discounts, tax treatment, approval limits or validity periods. Technical feasibility and commercial authorization are different checks.

Before sending, reconcile the customer request, survey and draft quotation. Look for mismatched quantities, unclear installation scope and unsupported compatibility claims. Use a version identifier so reviewers discuss the same document. If the customer changes requirements, record the change and obtain the necessary revised review rather than editing a signed or approved document silently.
lessons.example: A fictional survey calls for six camera locations, but the draft quotation lists four cameras. Flag the mismatch before issue.
lessons.exercise: Review a sample quotation checklist with scope, quantity, exclusions, version and approval fields.
lessons.model_response: The quantity mismatch is unresolved; the quotation remains a draft. Ask the technical and commercial reviewers to confirm the revised scope.
lessons.thai_summary: ตรวจสอบขอบเขต จำนวน และเวอร์ชันก่อนส่งใบเสนอราคา เงื่อนไขราคาและอำนาจอนุมัติต้องมาจากบริษัท
lessons.summary: Reconcile scope and quantities Separate technical and commercial review Track revisions explicitly

lessons.title: Administrative records and handovers
objectives: Maintain accurate controlled documents and protect confidentiality.
explanation: Use clear names, stable references and version information so another person can locate the right record. Check dates, quantities, customer identifiers and attachments against the source. A copied spreadsheet can become an uncontrolled duplicate; follow the approved storage and retention rules once supplied. Do not invent a retention period.

Restrict access according to the task, verify recipients and use approved transfer methods. A handover should state status, outstanding questions, evidence location and next owner or requested action. Do not mark a task complete merely because an email was sent. Confirm that the intended outcome or handover acceptance has been recorded by the appropriate person.
lessons.example: Two files are named final.xlsx. In the exercise, assign a stable request reference and explicit version, then identify which version is approved.
lessons.exercise: Prepare a handover for a draft quotation awaiting technical review.
lessons.model_response: CO-101 v0.2 remains Draft; six-location scope awaits confirmation. Evidence is in the authorized case folder. Technical review requested before commercial approval.
key_points: Handover requires a clear next action
lessons.thai_summary: ใช้เลขอ้างอิง เวอร์ชัน และสถานะให้ชัด ตรวจสอบข้อมูลกับต้นทางและส่งต่องานพร้อมรายการที่ยังค้าง
